summary: Structure confirmed by four independent sources: each broadcast block adapts a DIFFERENT manga. S1 (our eps 1-10) is a complete adaptation of the 1st manga (13 chapters + epilogue, 2 volumes — exactly our 14-chapter space); 2wei! TV (our 11-19) + 2wei Herz! (our 20-29) together adapt the 2wei! manga (5 vols, 27 numbered chapters on MangaDex; AniList manga 85136); 3rei!! TV (our 30-41) adapts the early 3rei!! manga (AniList 66131); and our ep 42 is the 2017 movie Sekka no Chikai / Oath Under Snow, which adapts 3rei!! chapters 29-39 (= 3rei vols 7-8), a Shirou/Miyu flashback that follows the S4 finale. S1 is now fully anchored 1:1 in our space via near-verbatim episode-title = chapter-title matches (8 of 10 episodes title-locked; the other 2 forced by pigeonhole under the attested complete adaptation). The existing ep-42 pin (ch 13, MU-derived) is a wrong-chapter-space heal artifact and is repaired to removal: the movie touches zero 1st-series chapters. Volume boundary confirmed twice: v1 = ch 1-5, v2 = ch 6-13 + epilogue.

repairs.why: Ep 42 is the 2017 movie Sekka no Chikai (Oath Under Snow), which adapts Fate/kaleid liner PRISMA ILLYA 3rei!! chapters 29-39 (TYPE-MOON wiki) = 3rei volumes 7-8 'almost faithfully' (ja.wikipedia: 原作コミック（『ドライ!!』）の7巻、8巻をほぼ忠実に映像化), a Shirou/Miyu flashback following the S4 finale. It adapts ZERO chapters of the 1st-series manga; the ch-13 pin was an MU final-episode heal applied in the wrong chapter space (MU latest_chapter 13 belongs to the 1st series). Remove the anchor; treat ep 42 as order-only until a 3rei-scoped chapter space exists.

structure.notes: Franchise = three successive manga by Hiroshi Hiroyama, each with its own chapter space: (1) 1st series, Comp Ace 2007-2008, 13 chapters + epilogue in 2 volumes (TYPE-MOON wiki '13 + Epilogue (Complete)'; MU latest ch 13; AniList 33526 counts 14 = incl. epilogue) — OUR current chapter space, v1 = ch 1-5, v2 = ch 6-13+epilogue (MangaDex + MU release listings agree). (2) 2wei!, 2009-2012, 5 vols, 27 numbered chapters on MangaDex (AniList 85136 lists 34 incl. specials). (3) 3rei!!, 2012-, long-running (AniList 66131, RELEASING). Season->manga: S1 (our 1-10) = complete adaptation of the 1st series (en+ja Wikipedia, TYPE-MOON wiki, WDTALO all agree); 2wei! TV = first half of the 2wei! manga and Herz! = the remainder (Wikipedia; WDTALO: 'two-season anime, complete adaptation'); 3rei!! TV (our 30-41) = early 3rei; ep 42 = movie Oath Under Snow = 3rei ch 29-39 / vols 7-8 (flashback prequel-in-content, sequel-in-airing). Numbering: our rows drop 2wei TV ep 1 'Illya Grow Up!?' (ja.wikipedia table confirms it exists; our ep 11 'Illya x Illya' = 2wei source ep 2), consistent with the SOURCE_NUMBERING_SHIFTS ruling {drop 11, -1 from 12}; so 2wei src 2-10 = our 11-19, Herz 1-10 = our 20-29, 3rei 1-12 = our 30-41, movie = 42. Component metadata ranges (11-20/21-30/31-42) reflect pre-shift numbering, rows are authoritative. Undoukai DE Dance OVA (AniList 18851) is unnumbered order-only between S1 and 2wei.

flags_for_sean: SCOPING RECOMMENDATION (the ask): keep this entry's chapter space = 1st-series manga only; eps 1-10 are now fully anchored in it and the manga is 100% adapted. Eps 11-42 adapt DIFFERENT manga and must not be interpolated in this 14-chapter space. Recommend a Clear-Card-style split: a 2wei-scoped entry (our eps 11-29 -> 2wei! manga, AniList 85136, 5 vols / 27 numbered chapters) and a 3rei-scoped entry (our eps 30-41 + ep 42 movie -> 3rei!! manga, AniList 66131). Until split, eps 11-42 should render as out-of-space/order-only rather than pending-interpolation.

ep-42 pin repaired to removal (was ch 13, MU heal in wrong space). If/when a 3rei-scoped space exists, the movie pins there as START 29 / END 39 (TYPE-MOON wiki 'Chapter 29 to 39'; ja.wikipedia '3rei vols 7-8 almost faithfully') — sources already in the repair entry.
Continue point after ep 10 is 2wei! ch 1 (a different manga), so no in-space continue_chapter exists; the honest reader guidance is 'start 2wei!'.
For future 3rei scoping: WDTALO states the post-anime/post-movies resume point is 3rei ch 53.4 (single source, unverified — re-verify when that entry is built).

2wei Herz! coverage detail: WDTALO also notes 'the ending of the 2wei manga is much different compared to the anime and many events in 3rei are changed' — expect divergence annotations when the 2wei space is researched, not a clean 1:1 tail.
